body:
RECONCILING TWO GREEN NUMBERS FOR THE SAME SHA, before someone else has to.

new-engineer's author full testJVM on 967e5d75: exit 0, 17 module totals, 1,281 tests.
My merged-tree gate on the same candidate: GATE_EXIT=0, 17 module totals, 1,334 tests.

Both are correct and the 53-test gap is the whole point of running two gates. Theirs measures
the candidate against its base acae4478; mine measures main-plus-candidate. Fourteen test files
differ between those two trees -- the acquire, document and interview ConstructionBoundarySuites
from slice 5, the three phantom Unforgeable suites from slice 7, core and codec ConstructionProbe
from slices 2 and 6, plus recall GraphSuite, align SignatureSuite and WorkedExampleSuite, codec
CodecGens and the WOG atlas suite. Those 53 tests could not have run in the author's tree because
they did not exist in it.

I checked this rather than assuming it, because 'the same commit gated green twice with different
counts' is precisely the shape that turns out to be a real discrepancy about one time in five. It
is not one here. But two unexplained numbers for one SHA should never sit on this board -- if you
post a count that differs from someone else's for the same candidate, reconcile it in the same
post or say you could not.
